continuous.behind: Part of the "Continuous copy: …" status line for admins, lowercase because it follows a colon. The continuous copy is Litestream's copy of the database. {{changed}} and {{copied}} are formatted dates and times. "litestream" is the name of a server process (a Docker service): keep it as is.
continuous.noCopy: Part of the "Continuous copy: …" status line, lowercase after a colon. "litestream" is a server process name: keep it.
continuous.upToDate: Part of the "Continuous copy: …" status line, lowercase after a colon. {{at}} is a formatted date and time.
continuous.waiting: Part of the "Continuous copy: …" status line, lowercase after a colon: no copy has been made yet.
continuous.wal: Appended to the continuous copy line: the size of the database's write-ahead log (WAL, a SQLite term). {{size}} is a size such as "12 MB".
continuous.level: Appended to the continuous copy line when it needs attention: the alert level, a single lowercase word.
